plate_findings.evidence: increased dermal fibroblastic proliferation with thickened collagen

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Low-power skin histology from NSF case-report article showing dermal fibroblastic proliferation with thickened collagen and widened fibrous septae, matching dermal fibrocyte infiltration vocabulary. B: Higher-power dermal histology showing fibroblastic proliferation with thickened collagen fibers in confirmed NSF case, direct match to dense dermal spindle-cell fibrocytes. C: IHC panel showing factor XIIIa-positive dermal fibroblastic cells in NSF skin, supporting dermal fibrocyte proliferation lineage. D: IHC panel showing CD34-positive dermal fibroblastic cells in NSF skin, directly matching CD34-positive fibrocytes synonym of the finding.
